text:
Maya R: quick thought — the onboarding quickstart feels long. can we make a lean 3-step flow (auth -> run -> first deploy) and push the rest to an expanded reference?

Chris H: +1. heavy on prose right now. propose we keep one minimal curl example but promote the SDK snippet to primary.

Jen D: I like keeping curl in an "advanced" toggle. migration note: SDK8 changed env var names, need a short callout.

Sam K: I can take the deploy snippet. thinking a tiny serverless example using the starter template so users can see one-click deploy. snippet draft:```yaml
name: hello-redwood
runtime: node16
env:
  REDWOOD_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_KEY }}
steps:
  - run: npm install
  - run: npm run start
```

Maya R: perfect — keep that under "first deploy". also add a tiny troubleshooting note about 401s and clock skew + link to token FAQ: https://redwood.example/docs/token-faq

Chris H: @Jen D can you add the SDK8 env var migration line? something like: "OLD_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY" and a 1-liner example for linux export.

Jen D: on it. one more: the quickstart currently uses `client.generate()` in examples; API v2 is `responses.create()` now. want to update examples across the doc. I'll open a PR for snippets and a follow-up for prose edits.

docs-bot: snippet PR opened — #4523 (docs/snippets/compact-onboard). CI checks queued. :white_check_mark:

Sam K: thanks — I'll add the serverless template to the PR as a subdir and include a tiny README for deploy steps.

Maya R: can we get a preview deploy URL once CI builds? would be nice for engineering review.

preview-bot: preview deployed: https://staging-docs.redwood.example/compact-onboard — expires in 7 days.

Chris H: quick review note: the sample token in the README is literal `redwood_key=abc123`. change to `REDACTED` or env placeholder.

Jen D: good catch. I'll replace with `<YOUR_KEY>` across snippets.

Maya R: timeline? trying to ship this in the next docs sprint.

Sam K: PR is up now, I'll loop QE after preview looks good. aiming EOD Wednesday.

Chris H: sounds good. tagging @Maya R for final signoff once edits land. :thumbsup:
